title: PhaseHandoff
description: Main-session ↔ sub-coordinator handoff contract. Each phase subagent returns one of phase_a_output / phase_b_output / phase_c_output. Main session parses by this schema — no prose interpretation. All phases write exceptions to $WORKSPACE/phase-<a|b|c>-error.json and set error_path; main session relays that file to the user verbatim and stops.

cwd.description: Main session's current working directory. Phase A computes $SCOPE by walking up to the nearest CLAUDE.md from here.

user_request.description: Verbatim /preflight invocation — argument, pasted text, or the chat-handle keyword.

now_iso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at invocation. Phase A uses this to timestamp $WORKSPACE name deterministically.

user_language.description: Free-form name of the user's working language (e.g. 'Russian', 'English'). Detected by the main session from the chat context. Sub-coordinator renders user-facing prose (gate.md) in this language; machine artefacts (brief.md, JSON) stay English. Default 'English' when omitted.

resume_from.description: Workspace path if user chose to resume an interrupted run; null otherwise.

gate_answers.description: Only present on Phase A re-iteration — user's answers to the previous gate that changed load-bearing facts, forcing brief/ground_truth regeneration.

cost_profile.description: Cost/quality tradeoff profile. 'fast' skips adversarial (7.5), verifier (8.5), forces sonnet for synthesizer. Default 'thorough' when absent.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path to $WORKSPACE. Main session passes this as input to Phase B and stores for potential resume.

last_completed_step.description: Highest step completed. Normal completion = 6 (gate emitted or auto-proceed decided).

gate.description: null when no blockers (auto-proceed to Phase B). Object when user must answer.

questions_count.description: Count of questions in gate.json — capped at 4 to fit AskUserQuestion (see SKILL.md 'Handle the handoff'). If > 4, Phase A aborts instead (see 'aborted').

render.description: Markdown body of gate.md. Used as a fallback render path when gate.json cannot be parsed structurally or when every question is type=open. Emit empty string AND render_too_long: true when gate.md exceeds 4000 chars — main session falls back to reading the file from disk.

render_too_long.description: Set true when gate.md was too large to inline; main session reads workspace_path/gate.md instead.

gate_json_path.description: Absolute path to $WORKSPACE/gate.json — the structured form of the gate. Main session reads this and renders binary/choice questions through AskUserQuestion (interactive picker), with text fallback for type=open. See SKILL.md 'Handle the handoff' for the rendering contract.

aborted.description: Set when Phase A decided the premise is broken and panel should not run. Main session surfaces reason to user and stops.

error_path.description: Absolute path to $WORKSPACE/phase-a-error.json if an exception was raised. Main session reads, prints, and stops.

signals.description: Signal-group slugs detected in brief.md whose augments_roles intersect the selected panel. Written to $WORKSPACE/signals.json by Phase A step 6. Empty array when no signals match.

gate_answers_path.description: Absolute path to gate_answers.json if gate ran; null if Phase A auto-proceeded.

user_language.description: Same string passed to Phase A. Phase B passes it to the synthesizer (which renders user-facing strings in this language) and uses it to translate report.md section headings. Default 'English' when omitted.

resume_token.description: v0.7.0+: set on coordinator re-spawns within a single Phase B run (after main has executed the previous dispatch's Agent calls and written results to workspace). The coordinator uses it (alongside _index.json.last_completed_step and which workspace files exist) to decide what to do next. null on first spawn.

cost_profile.description: Cost/quality tradeoff profile. Passed by main on every Phase B spawn. Default 'thorough' when absent.

phase_b_output.description: v0.7.0 discriminated union by action. action='complete' is wire-compatible with v0.6.x (carries report_path, report, etc.). action='dispatch' is the new round-trip handoff: main executes the requested Agent calls, writes results to save_to paths, re-spawns coordinator with resume_token. action='error' carries error_path. See docs/specs/2026-05-03-phase-b-main-driven-dispatch.md.

last_completed_step.description: Highest pipeline step whose output is complete in workspace. May be 6 on first spawn (Phase A handoff just landed, nothing in Phase B done yet) — main session re-spawns the coordinator which then emits the step-7 dispatch.

report_path.description: Absolute path to $WORKSPACE/report.md. Required when action=='complete'.

report.description: Markdown body of report.md. Emit empty string AND report_too_long: true when report.md exceeds 15000 chars — main session falls back to reading from report_path. Only meaningful when action=='complete'.

skipped_experts.description: Roles whose expert call failed twice and were dropped from synthesis. Only populated when action=='complete'.

drift_refreshed.description: True when step-8 drift pre-check re-ran file_verifications/already_done against a moved HEAD. Only populated when action=='complete'.

dispatch.description: Required when action=='dispatch'. Describes the batch of Agent calls main session must execute before re-spawning the coordinator.

error_path.description: Required when action=='error'. Absolute path to $WORKSPACE/phase-b-error.json.

phase_b_dispatch.description: v0.7.0+: dispatch handoff payload. Coordinator returns one of these to main; main executes the Agent calls and re-spawns coordinator with resume_token.

step.description: Pipeline step the dispatch corresponds to.

step_label.description: Human-readable step name for logs and telemetry, e.g. 'parallel-experts', 'adversarial-round', 'synthesizer', 'verification-mini-round'.

parallelism.description: 'parallel' = main sends single message with N Agent calls. 'sequential' = main sends them one at a time.

id.description: Stable identifier (role name, claim id, etc.) used by coordinator on resume to map result files to logical units.

subagent_type.description: Subagent type for the Agent spawn. Always 'general-purpose' under v0.7.0.

model_hint.description: Model recommendation (e.g. 'haiku', 'sonnet', 'opus'). Main session passes this to Agent's model parameter. Per-task choice based on cognitive load.

description.description: Short description for the Agent spawn, e.g. 'Preflight expert: security'.

prompt.description: Complete prompt body. Coordinator has already done all assembly (role prompt + discipline blocks + role-KB + context_pack slice + delimited artifact). Main is a dumb executor — do NOT modify.

save_to.description: Absolute path. Main writes the Agent call's response there verbatim.

schema_ref.description: Optional JSON-schema reference (e.g. 'schemas/expert-report.json') the response should validate against. Informational — main does not enforce.

on_failure.description: 'mark_skipped' = main records failure in _index.json.dispatch[<id>] and continues. 'abort' = main stops the loop, surfaces error to user, no Phase C.

resume_token.description: Opaque string main passes back to coordinator on the next spawn. Coordinator uses it as a hint alongside workspace-file existence (which is the source of truth).

user_language.description: Same string passed to Phases A and B. Phase C forwards it to the rubber-duck so polishing preserves the language the synthesizer already rendered. Default 'English' when omitted.

resume_token.description: v0.7.0+: set on coordinator re-spawns within a single Phase C run (after main has executed the previous dispatch's Agent calls and written results to workspace). The coordinator uses it (alongside _index.json.last_completed_step and which workspace files exist) to decide what to do next. null on first spawn. BG_LOOP_OK confirmed by 2026-05-03 probe — see skills/preflight/docs/notes/2026-05-03-phase-c-bg-loop-probe.md.

phase_c_output.description: v0.7.0 discriminated union by action. action='complete' is wire-compatible with v0.6.x (carries polished_report_path, duck_skipped, kb_summary). action='dispatch' is the new round-trip handoff for the rubber-duck (step 10) or KB compactor (step 11). action='error' carries error_path; Phase C errors are non-blocking — main surfaces but does not retract the report.

last_completed_step.description: May be 9 on first spawn (Phase B handoff just landed, nothing in Phase C done yet).

polished_report_path.description: Absolute path to report.polished.md, or null when the rubber-duck step was skipped (chat/inline target or < 4k artifact). Required when action=='complete'.

kb_summary.description: One-line summary for main session to surface: 'KB applied: <role1>:+N, ... · compacted: <roles>'. Required when action=='complete'.

error_path.description: Required when action=='error'. Absolute path to $WORKSPACE/phase-c-error.json.

phase_c_dispatch.description: v0.7.0+: Phase C dispatch handoff payload. Same shape as phase_b_dispatch but step enum is restricted to ['10', '11'] and parallelism is typically 'sequential' (single rubber-duck call) or 'parallel' (one KB compactor call per role).

synth_result.description: Output written to $WORKSPACE/synth_result.json by the synthesizer Agent (step 8). Phase B reads this to render report.md. All properties are documented here for reference; the synthesizer is the authoritative source of this structure. correlated_bias_risk and evidence_thinness are optional (not in required[]) for backward compat — old synth_result.json from pre-port runs omit them; Phase B render hook checks for existence before rendering banners. Adversarial-round summary lives in $WORKSPACE/adversarial_round.json (separate file), not in this object — Phase B step 7.5 writes that file directly.

must_fix.description: Each item may carry optional verification: {status: verified|unverified|inconclusive, note: string} after step 8.5.

correlated_bias_risk.description: True when all experts agreed (no decisions, no untouched_concerns) on >=2 findings with panel size >=3. Signals possible echo-chamber.

evidence_thinness.description: Fraction of surviving findings (must+should+nice after filters) with evidence_source==reasoning. High value means panel mostly speculated.

verification_round.description: Summary written by Phase B step 8.5. Absent on old runs or when skipped. v0.7.1+ adds rescued_should_to_must (ground-truth-rescue promotion path) — older runs omit the field; renderer guards on existence.

rescued_should_to_must.description: v0.7.1+: count of SHOULD claims promoted back to MUST when verifier returned status=verified with non-null ground_truth_match AND the claim title carried the synthesizer rule-5b downgrade prefix. See sub-coordinator-phase-b.md step 8.5.resume rescue rule.

disputed_findings.description: Findings challenged in adversarial round. Populated by synthesizer §1 adversarial pass. Empty array [] on non-adversarial runs.
